provenance.notes:
bosses/bulwark-plate (1f 9×27 served; one of the four shield plates stacked in front of the core) — the 1 cells cropped to their measured subject boxes with the 6-px key border clamped inside each cell; single frame; the sheet state probe floor 0.4%. The design carries its own 1-px outline, so the outline pass is off.

Pixel-art sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: the single frame of a HALCYON BULWARK shield plate — one of the tall armour slabs stacked vertically in front of the boss core.

Design identity to keep exactly — a TALL, NARROW vertical armour bar about one-third as wide as it is high: pale steel face (#7a9cc8) with a bright white highlight edge (#d0e4ff) running down its left side, a darker slate shadow channel (#3e5a86) down its right third, small bolted seams, chamfered caps on top and bottom, all on a 1-px near-black outline (#0a1428). A solid, heavy, full-height shield lamella that is WIDE, not a blade: its width is a generous 35 to 45 percent of its height (about 2 bars could almost sit side by side in the cell) — NEVER a thin spear, sword, wire or needle silhouette.

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.
- EXACTLY 1 cell laid out as 1 ROW OF 1 (one single cell = the whole canvas) holding exactly ONE plate; the canvas IS one cell.
- Cells in reading order (left-right, then top-bottom):
  cell 1 = the plate standing upright, full height — a wide, solid vertical bar. The subject lies within aspect 0.26:1 to 0.45:1.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 256×512 px. Produce EXACTLY 1 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Each subject sits well inside its cell with at least 12 px of unbroken flat #51e018 around it and clean flat gutters between cells: no subject may touch or cross a cell edge; keep every subject within the inner 75% of its cell.
- CENTRING AND SIZE: the plate stands upright at the exact centre of the canvas, nearly full cell height, keeping at least 12 px of flat key to every edge.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: the finest retro pixel art for its native resolution — as much detail and inner structure as possible AT that low resolution, crisp hard-edged square pixels, chunky bold forms, a rich four-to-six step shading ramp lit from the top-left with careful inner detail and real material texture, clean saturated colours, a 1-px near-black outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth gradients.
